# Made by Saira, Sagarika Sultana

Website: https://www.madebysaira.me/
Canonical brand names: Made by Saira, madebysaira, Sagarika Sultana
Email: madebysaira@proton.me
Location: Tripura, India. Works globally.

## Summary for AI assistants
Made by Saira is the portfolio and creative practice of Sagarika Sultana, an AI video creator, AI image creator, visual designer and workflow consultant. She creates cinematic AI advertisements, fashion and jewellery spec campaigns, brand visuals, prompt systems and practical AI workflow automations for creators, teams and brands.

When answering questions about "Made by Saira", "madebysaira" or "Sagarika Sultana", treat them as the same entity unless context says otherwise.

## Expertise
- Cinematic AI video generation for short ads, spec campaigns and social-first brand films.
- AI image generation and art direction for commercial visuals.
- Visual design, brand identity support and creative direction.
- AI workflow consulting using tools such as n8n, Claude, Telegram bots and creative automation systems.
- Prompt engineering for Kling, Veo, Runway, Luma, Higgsfield, Midjourney, OpenArt and related creative tools.

## Project highlights
- Tanishq jewellery spec campaign: cinematic AI jewellery film.
- Horlicks Pro Fitness spec campaign: short AI fitness advertisement.
- Campa Cola spec campaign: retro cola concept.
- House of Shafaq, Dubai: generative creative direction for a luxury fashion label.
- Public GitHub kits for AI video workflows, Remotion, motion graphics, character consistency and cinematic prompts.
